title: AdminUtils
description: This datapack add a dialog screen with some functions which can help server adminstrators or datapack testers
body: This datapack have 5 functions which can help users, who have some problems with diffrent commands. You can easly enchant any item(block) with every enchantment on 1-255 level. You can also repair item into your inventory/hotbar/mainhand/offhand/armor slots. If you want to test any modifier which add extra protection from some damage source, you can use damage menu. You can give player skull by his name. And last feature - you can control weather and time.
